subject: english
question: What should come in the place of blank number (4)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**co-opted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes how gestures of resistance are handled by the systems they are trying to subvert.
 
• The text immediately clarifies this blank with the phrase "**recuperated as marketable deviance, branded subcultures, or managed dissent**," meaning the system absorbs the rebellion and turns it into a commodity or a controlled part of itself.
 
• "**Co-opted**" perfectly describes this process; it means to assimilate, appropriate, or adopt something (especially a dissenting idea or group) into a larger or established system.
 
• Other options ("**invalidated**", "**misread**", "**repelled**") do not align with the system absorbing and profiting from the resistance.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage Snippet: *...Within this ontological reconfiguration, resistance too undergoes a semiotic shift. Acts of refusal no longer manifest through overt defiance but through obfuscation, misalignment, and withdrawal from legibility. Yet even these gestures risk being 4. **co-opted**__ by the very systems they attempt to subvert—recuperated as marketable deviance, branded subcultures, or managed dissent. If every deviation is eventually re-circulated as novelty...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Invalidated (अमान्य करना): To make something legally or officially void. This contradicts the system finding a use for the dissent as a "branded subculture."
 
• Misread (गलत समझना): To interpret incorrectly. The system isn't misunderstanding the resistance; it is actively exploiting it.
 
• Repelled (पीछे हटाना): To force back or drive away. This is the opposite of absorbing and "recuperating" the dissent into the system.
